claimLevel: I1 (protocol-passed) — reference-client harness, real streams, planted mutants. NOT I2: no index-conformance or position-mapping assertion is made here, and NOT I3: no named editor run is part of this evidence.

advertisement.note: bb/staleness and bb/impact carry non-standard capability keys (LSP 3.18 has no impactProvider). They ride top-level keys exactly as bb/graph already did via graphProvider, each carrying the schemaVersion the handler ENFORCES, so a client can detect a mismatch before sending one. A client that ignores unknown capability keys can still call them; discoverability is the point, not enforcement.

verdict.note: `failed` counts real functional failures only; mutant runs are reported separately via the verdict block. A mutant caught ONLY by a load failure is reported but does NOT satisfy the suite.

reviewers.separationOfDuties: NOT satisfied for this change: the author of the component change wrote the only gate covering it (contract §8.6 requires cross-review where feasible). Owner spot-check (§8.5) is the closure authority.
reviewers.crossReview: requested from script/m26/verify-graph-transport.ts owner: its M5 mutant anchors on the literal graphProvider line in src/lsp/server.ts, which is why that line was preserved rather than replaced by a table lookup.

limitations: single-root workspaces only (multi-root is a filed decision for later waves); declared on the wire as workspace.workspaceFolders.supported = false
no completion, no diagnostics, no rename (complement stance, §7.1)

no textDocumentSync is advertised, because no textDocument/did* handler exists; the declared sync model is filesystem-side (recursive fs.watch, 300 ms debounce, incremental reindex, scan-on-read fallback) and no latency figure is advertised because this gate measures none
stdio framing is byte-stream based with Content-Length parsing
bb/staleness and bb/impact use non-standard capability keys; a client that ignores unknown keys cannot discover them from the initialize result
the mutation suite plants into src/lsp/ and deletes the copy in a finally block; a crash mid-run can leave a server.mutant.<pid>.<n>.ts file behind (git status shows untracked files)
G7 exercises bb/staleness on an UNINDEXED workspace only; the marker shape for a fresh/stale indexed file is freshness.ts's contract, gated by script/m25, not here
